markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Lantern_Shoal
markers.note: A shoal of lights that leads somewhere if you keep up. It does not wait.

markers.name: INT_Pressure_Door
markers.note: Takes two players turning opposite wheels at once.

markers.name: INT_The_Singing_Coral
markers.note: Each branch is a note. Play the right five and something opens below.

markers.name: INT_Air_Pocket_Chapel
markers.note: A dry room at the bottom of the sea. Someone has been living here.

markers.name: INT_The_Anchor
markers.note: Attached to something that is not a boat.

markers.name: INT_Message_Bottles
markers.note: Notes from players who drowned here.

markers.name: INT_Bioluminescent_Switchboard
markers.note: Rerouting the light changes which corridors are safe.

markers.name: INT_The_Whale_Skeleton
markers.note: Something is nesting in it. It is friendly, mostly.

markers.name: INT_Tide_Organ
markers.note: The current plays it. You can change the tuning and the current follows.

markers.name: INT_Sunken_Vending_Machine
markers.note: Still works. Still takes Credits. Dispenses dry snacks.

markers.name: INT_The_Drowned_Museum
markers.note: Somebody else's trophy room, flooded. Their artifacts are still on the pedestals.

markers.name: INT_The_Depth_Marker
markers.note: Counts down as you descend. Below zero it keeps counting.
